description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of several reinforcement learning methods, both with and without self-reflection, across three datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets – Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics – listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents values ranging from 50 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each dataset, there are four bars representing different methods: “DAPO+Self-reflection” (blue), “DAPO” (grey), “SRPO” (orange), and “PPO+Self-reflection” (green). Within each dataset, each bar represents the accuracy achieved by the respective method. For Mathverse, the bars have approximate heights of 53, 55, 52, and 54, respectively. For MMLU, the bars reach approximately 56, 55, 54, and 58. Finally, for Physics, the bars reach heights of roughly 61, 58, 60, and 59.  The bars are not sorted in any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
